description: This file is a shell script used for setting up and testing the 'bundle-uri' command in protocol v2 for a software project, specifically related to git operations. It configures different protocols ('file', 'git', 'http'), initializes repositories, and performs tests on bundle-uri handling and capability advertisement.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon with specified options to serve repositories.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP daemon for hosting repositories.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisite conditions for tests based on environment variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test step that should succeed, executing specified commands.

methods.name: test_cfg
methods.description: Configures git settings locally or globally for tests.

methods.name: test_uri_escape
methods.description: Escapes a URI to ensure it is safe for use in commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_config_output
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected configuration output.
